commitments.detail: Line 4 will be authorized to use the closed-loop rinse-recovery skid starting Monday.
The closed-loop rinse-recovery skid will be purged every 10 cycles, with each purge volume set at 500 liters.
There will be 8 hours of downtime for commissioning the closed-loop rinse-recovery skid.
The pH of the rinse water will be maintained between 6.5 and 7.5.
